retrievalProfile.description: A close-up, contemplative male portrait featuring a prominent white cowboy hat and textured leather, utilizing dramatic rim lighting and a shallow depth of field.
triggerTerms: man in white cowboy hat looking down
excludeWhen: bright high-key outdoor lighting is requested
traditional vintage sepia western styles are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, profile-oriented portrait of a man with light facial stubble, wearing a crisp white felt cowboy hat tilted forward. He is dressed in a dark, metallic-sheen leather jacket over a black t-shirt. The lighting is moody and directional, creating a bright highlight on the hat's brim and the subject's profile while leaving the background in a soft, dark, multi-tonal blur.
coreVisualRelationships: The white hat acts as a high-contrast frame for the face
The metallic texture of the jacket contrasts with the matte felt of the hat
The downward gaze creates a somber, introspective mood
Rim lighting separates the dark jacket from the dark background
coreInvariants: White felt cowboy hat with a wide brim
Dark leather jacket with visible hardware like zippers

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned centrally and tightly cropped, occupying approximately 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white curve of the cowboy hat brim serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the bright hat brim, follows the line of the nose downward to the chin, and then moves to the textured details of the jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper left and lower right corners with a dark, mottled texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the clothing and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white of the cowboy hat providing maximum tonal contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and subtle gold/bronze reflections on the jacket zippers and fabric.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the hat and the rest of the composition.
paletteRestrictions: Limit background to muted earth tones and deep blues

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail portrait of a man in a white cowboy hat and black leather jacket, looking down in a contemplative pose. Use a dark, out-of-focus studio background with subtle teal and brown mottling. Apply strong rim lighting to the hat and shoulder.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif or a modern slab-serif in white, positioned in the lower third or upper corner to avoid obscuring the face.

verificationChecks: Is the hat the brightest element?
Is the subject's gaze directed downward?
Are the leather textures and zipper details sharp?

adjustableVariables: texture of the leather jacket (matte vs. shiny)
mustRedesign: Do not use a busy or recognizable outdoor background
Ensure the hat is not cropped off at the top

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the facial features and stubble
Clean, crisp edges on the white hat
Rich, deep blacks without losing detail in the jacket

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic felt texture on the hat
Verify the metallic sheen on the jacket zippers
Ensure the downward gaze feels natural and not forced
Confirm the color palette remains moody and muted
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [high-contrast white accessory] with [dark textured apparel] against a [mottled dark background] using [dramatic rim lighting] and a [contemplative downward pose].
